function.arguments:
{"query":"SELECT
  SEM_NORM(trainee, 'canonicalize chef names; preserve different people') AS trainee,
  SEM_NORM(mentor, 'canonicalize chef names; preserve different people; expand Roux brothers only when a page names an individual') AS mentor,
  COUNT(DISTINCT url) AS source_mentions,
  MODE(kitchen) FILTER (WHERE kitchen IS NOT NULL) AS kitchen,
  MODE(relationship) FILTER (WHERE relationship IS NOT NULL) AS relationship,
  MODE(period) FILTER (WHERE period IS NOT NULL) AS period,
  FIRST(url ORDER BY CASE
    WHEN url LIKE '%guide.michelin.com%' THEN 1
    WHEN url LIKE '%theworlds50best.com%' THEN 2
    WHEN url LIKE '%britannica.com%' THEN 3
    WHEN url LIKE '%greatbritishchefs.com%' THEN 4
    WHEN url LIKE '%nytimes.com%' THEN 5
    ELSE 9
  END) AS source_url,
  FIRST(title ORDER BY CASE
    WHEN url LIKE '%guide.michelin.com%' THEN 1
    WHEN url LIKE '%theworlds50best.com%' THEN 2
    WHEN url LIKE '%britannica.com%' THEN 3
    WHEN url LIKE '%greatbritishchefs.com%' THEN 4
    WHEN url LIKE '%nytimes.com%' THEN 5
    ELSE 9
  END) AS source_title
FROM (
  SELECT trainee, mentor, kitchen, relationship, period, url, title
  FROM r6c7937c138f
  UNION ALL
  SELECT trainee, mentor, kitchen, relationship, period, url, title
  FROM r4c371caffa5
  UNION ALL
  SELECT trainee, mentor, kitchen, relationship, period, url, title
  FROM r17a38efc992
  UNION ALL
  SELECT trainee, mentor, kitchen, relationship, period, url, title
  FROM ra76badbfe20
)
WHERE trainee IS NOT NULL
  AND mentor IS NOT NULL
  AND trainee <> mentor
  AND LENGTH(trainee) < 45
  AND LENGTH(mentor) < 45
GROUP BY
  SEM_NORM(trainee, 'canonicalize chef names; preserve different people'),
  SEM_NORM(mentor, 'canonicalize chef names; preserve different people; expand Roux brothers only when a page names an individual')
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT url) >= 2
ORDER BY source_mentions DESC
LIMIT 150","show_preview":false}
